verdict.rationale: Vercel provides per-environment variables (local/preview/production/custom) so different credentials/secrets can be used per environment, plus preview URL access controls (Vercel Authentication, passwords, trusted IPs) and project/team-scoped access tokens that deny cross-project reach — all of which support isolating non-prod from prod resources. However, community evidence indicates that securely connecting to backend services (e.g., databases) with more than a password requires an 'enterprise' sales conversation, suggesting robust network-level isolation isn't a self-serve default. Missing for 10: documented VPC/network-level segmentation or firewall rules specifically preventing preview environments from reaching production services, and independent confirmation that env-var separation alone effectively blocks cross-environment access.
